source.text: לְ֭כוּ נְרַנְּנָ֣ה לַיהוָ֑ה נָ֝רִ֗יעָה לְצ֣וּר יִשְׁעֵֽנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Come, let us sing for joy to YHWH; let us shout aloud to [the] rock of our salvation.

en.L: Come, let us sing for joy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}; \q let us shout aloud to the rock of our salvation.
en.B: Come, let us sing out with joy to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} \q and raise a glad shout to the Rock who saves us.
en.R: Come and sing to {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} with joy! \q Shout happily to God, our Rock, who rescues us.

fr.L: Venez, chantons de joie {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ; \q poussons des cris vers le rocher de notre salut.
fr.B: Venez, chantons avec joie {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} \q et lançons des cris joyeux vers le Rocher qui nous sauve.
fr.R: Venez chanter avec joie {{divine_name:au SEIGNEUR|à Yahvé}} ! \q Criez de bonheur pour Dieu, notre Rocher, qui nous délivre.

sw.L: Njooni, tumwimbie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa furaha; \q tumpigie kelele mwamba wa wokovu wetu.
sw.B: Njooni, tumwimbie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa shangwe \q na kumpigia kelele za furaha Mwamba anayetuokoa.
sw.R: Njooni tumwimbie {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} kwa furaha! \q Tumshangilie Mungu, Mwamba wetu, anayetuokoa.

es.L: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, cantemos con júbilo {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}; \q aclamemos a la roca de nuestra salvación.
es.B: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, cantemos con alegría {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}} \q y alcemos gritos de gozo a la Roca que nos salva.
es.R: ¡{{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}} a cantar con alegría {{divine_name:al SEÑOR|a Yahvé}}! \q {{plural_you:Griten|Gritad}} de felicidad a Dios, nuestra Roca, que nos rescata.

vi.L: Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy reo hát cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}; \q chúng ta hãy lớn tiếng tung hô vầng đá của sự cứu rỗi chúng ta.
vi.B: Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy cất tiếng hát vui mừng cho {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} \q và reo hò mừng rỡ với Vầng Đá, Đấng giải cứu chúng ta.
vi.R: Hãy đến hát mừng {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}! \q Hãy reo hò vui vẻ cho Đức Chúa Trời, Vầng Đá của chúng ta, Đấng giải cứu chúng ta.

decisions.choice: a psalm with no title
decisions.reason: The Hebrew gives this psalm no title. The ancient Greek translation adds one naming David, and Hebrews 4:7 speaks of God saying its words "through David". Psalms 93-100 belong together as songs of the LORD as King.

decisions.choice: the rock of our salvation: God who saves us
decisions.reason: A rock is a high, safe place no enemy can reach (18:3; 62:3). "Of our salvation" describes the rock: God is the strong one who saves his people.

decisions.choice: the Rock who saves us (B); God, our Rock, who rescues us (R)
decisions.reason: Balanced and Readable say what the phrase means (m2); Readable names God, since the rock stands for him.

decisions.choice: "Mwamba" with a capital at Balanced and Readable, where it names God
decisions.reason: The English Balanced and Readable write "Rock" as a name for God here; Swahili does the same, while Literal keeps the plain picture.

decisions.choice: Vengan, with Venid as the alternative
decisions.reason: The call is to the gathered worshipers, so the plural command takes the plural you setting: the Latin American form by default, the form of Spain as the alternative. The same holds in the calls to praise that follow.

decisions.choice: "chúng ta" for "us" when the singer calls the worshipers together
decisions.reason: The singer counts himself among those he calls to worship, so Vietnamese uses the inclusive "chúng ta"; "chúng tôi" is kept for the people speaking to God.

source.text: נְקַדְּמָ֣ה פָנָ֣יו בְּתוֹדָ֑ה בִּ֝זְמִר֗וֹת נָרִ֥יעַֽ לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: Let us come to meet his face with thanksgiving; with songs let us shout aloud to him.

en.L: Let us come before {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} face with thanksgiving; \q with songs let us shout aloud to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.
en.B: Let us go out to meet {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} with thanks, \q and lift a glad shout to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} in our songs.
en.R: Let us come to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} and thank {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q Let us sing songs and cheer for {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: Allons au-devant de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} face avec des actions de grâce ; \q par des chants, acclamons-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}.
fr.B: Allons à {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} rencontre avec des remerciements, \q et acclamons-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} par nos chants.
fr.R: Approchons-nous de {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} et remercions-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}. \q Chantons des chants et acclamons-{{deity_pronoun:le|Le}}.

sw.L: Tuje mbele ya uso {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} kwa shukrani; \q kwa nyimbo tumpigie kelele za shangwe.
sw.B: Twende kumlaki kwa shukrani, \q tumpigie kelele za furaha katika nyimbo zetu.
sw.R: Tumjie na kumshukuru. \q Tuimbe nyimbo na kumshangilia.

es.L: Lleguemos ante {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} rostro con acción de gracias; \q con cánticos aclamémoslo.
es.B: Salgamos a {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} encuentro con gratitud, \q y alcemos para {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} gritos de gozo con nuestros cantos.
es.R: Vamos a {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} y démosle gracias. \q Cantemos canciones y aclamémoslo.

vi.L: Chúng ta hãy đến trước mặt {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với lời cảm tạ; \q với những bài ca, chúng ta hãy lớn tiếng tung hô {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.
vi.B: Chúng ta hãy ra đón {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} với lời cảm tạ, \q và cất tiếng reo mừng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} bằng những bài ca.
vi.R: Chúng ta hãy đến với {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và cảm tạ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Chúng ta hãy hát những bài ca và reo hò mừng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: come to meet: come before, approach
decisions.reason: The verb (qiddem) is to come in front of someone, to meet him. With "his face" it means coming into God's presence, as people came to meet a king.

decisions.choice: thanksgiving: thanks spoken or sung
decisions.reason: The word (todah) is thanks, and also the offering brought to give thanks (Leviticus 7:12). Here it goes with songs, so spoken or sung thanks is meant first.

decisions.choice: songs: songs with music
decisions.reason: The word (zemirot) is used of songs sung to instruments.

source.text: כִּ֤י אֵ֣ל גָּד֣וֹל יְהוָ֑ה וּמֶ֥לֶךְ גָּ֝ד֗וֹל עַל־כָּל־אֱלֹהִֽים׃

records.literal_gloss: For a great God [is] YHWH, and a great king above all gods,

en.L: For a great God [is] {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, \q and a great King above all gods,
en.B: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is a mighty God, \q a mighty King high over all gods,
en.R: For {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} is a great God. \q He is the great King, far above anything people call a god.

fr.L: Car un grand Dieu, [c’est] {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, \q et un grand Roi au-dessus de tous les dieux,
fr.B: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est un Dieu puissant, \q un Roi puissant, bien au-dessus de tous les dieux,
fr.R: Car {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} est un grand Dieu. \q Il est le grand Roi, bien au-dessus de tout ce que les gens appellent un dieu.

sw.L: Kwa maana Mungu mkuu [ni] {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, \q na Mfalme mkuu juu ya miungu yote,
sw.B: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mungu mwenye nguvu, \q Mfalme mwenye nguvu aliye juu sana ya miungu yote,
sw.R: Kwa maana {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} ni Mungu mkuu. \q Yeye ni Mfalme mkuu, aliye juu sana ya kila kitu ambacho watu hukiita mungu.

es.L: Porque Dios grande [es] {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}}, \q y Rey grande sobre todos los dioses,
es.B: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es un Dios poderoso, \q un Rey poderoso, muy por encima de todos los dioses,
es.R: Porque {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} es un Dios grande. \q Él es el gran Rey, muy por encima de todo lo que la gente llama dios.

vi.L: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} [là] Đức Chúa Trời vĩ đại, \q và [là] Vua vĩ đại trên hết mọi thần,
vi.B: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đức Chúa Trời quyền năng, \q là Vua quyền năng cao trổi hơn mọi thần,
vi.R: Vì {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}} là Đức Chúa Trời vĩ đại. \q Ngài là Vua vĩ đại, cao hơn hết mọi thứ người ta gọi là thần.

decisions.choice: all gods: the gods the nations worshiped
decisions.reason: The psalm does not grant that these gods are real powers; Psalm 96:5 calls them worthless idols. It says that the LORD is King over everything that is called a god.

decisions.choice: King: the LORD as King of all
decisions.reason: Psalms 93 and 95-99 celebrate the LORD as King over his people, the nations and the whole of creation. "King" is a title of God here, so it is capitalized.

decisions.choice: a sentence that runs on
decisions.reason: Verses 4 and 5 begin with "who" and describe this King, so the sentence runs on and the verse ends with a comma at Literal and Balanced.

decisions.choice: anything people call a god
decisions.reason: Readable makes clear that the other gods are not real rivals (m1).

source.text: אֲשֶׁ֣ר בְּ֭יָדוֹ מֶחְקְרֵי־אָ֑רֶץ וְתוֹעֲפ֖וֹת הָרִ֣ים לֽוֹ׃

records.literal_gloss: who in his hand [are the] depths of [the] earth, and [the] peaks of [the] mountains [are] his,

en.L: in whose hand [are] the depths of the earth, \q and the peaks of the mountains [are] {{deity_pronoun:his|His}},
en.B: who holds the deep places of the earth in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand; \q the tops of the mountains are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} as well,
en.R: He holds the deepest places of the earth in {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand. \q The highest mountains belong to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}.

fr.L: {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui tient en {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main les profondeurs de la terre, \q et les sommets des montagnes [sont] à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}},
fr.B: {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui tient dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main les lieux profonds de la terre ; \q les sommets des montagnes sont à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} aussi,
fr.R: Il tient dans {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main les endroits les plus profonds de la terre. \q Les plus hautes montagnes {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} appartiennent.

sw.L: ambaye mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}} [zimo] sehemu za chini za nchi, \q na vilele vya milima [ni] {{deity_pronoun:vyake|Vyake}},
sw.B: ambaye anashika vilindi vya nchi mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}; \q vilele vya milima navyo ni {{deity_pronoun:vyake|Vyake}},
sw.R: Anashika mahali pa chini kabisa pa nchi mkononi {{deity_pronoun:mwake|Mwake}}. \q Milima mirefu kuliko yote ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}.

es.L: en cuya mano [están] las profundidades de la tierra, \q y las cumbres de los montes [son] {{deity_pronoun:suyas|Suyas}},
es.B: que tiene en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano los lugares profundos de la tierra; \q también las cimas de los montes son {{deity_pronoun:suyas|Suyas}},
es.R: Él tiene en {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano los lugares más profundos de la tierra. \q Los montes más altos {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pertenecen.

vi.L: những nơi sâu thẳm của đất [ở] trong tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, \q và những đỉnh núi [là] của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.B: Đấng cầm những nơi sâu thẳm của đất trong tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}; \q các đỉnh núi cũng thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}},
vi.R: Ngài nắm giữ những nơi sâu nhất của đất trong tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Những ngọn núi cao nhất thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}.

decisions.choice: depths: places to be searched out
decisions.reason: The word (mechqar) occurs only here; it comes from the verb "search out", so it is the hidden depths no one can explore.

decisions.choice: peaks: the heights
decisions.reason: The word (to'afot) is rare; it is used of the horns of a wild ox (Numbers 23:22), and here of the highest points of the mountains.

decisions.choice: the depths and the heights
decisions.reason: The lowest and highest parts of the earth stand for all of it: there is nothing outside the King's rule.

source.text: אֲשֶׁר־ל֣וֹ הַ֭יָּם וְה֣וּא עָשָׂ֑הוּ וְ֝יַבֶּ֗שֶׁת יָדָ֥יו יָצָֽרוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: who [has] the sea, for he made it, and [the] dry land his hands formed.

en.L: whose [is] the sea, for {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made it, \q and the dry land {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hands formed.
en.B: the sea belongs to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}} because {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} made it, \q and {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hands shaped the dry ground.
en.R: He made the sea, so it belongs to {{deity_pronoun:him|Him}}. \q With {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own hands {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} shaped the dry land.

fr.L: à qui [est] la mer, car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a faite, \q et la terre ferme, {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} mains l’ont formée.
fr.B: la mer est à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}, puisqu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} l’a faite, \q et {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} mains ont façonné la terre ferme.
fr.R: Il a fait la mer, alors elle est à {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}}. \q De {{deity_pronoun:ses|Ses}} propres mains, {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} a façonné la terre ferme.

sw.L: ambaye bahari [ni] {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}, kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliifanya, \q na nchi kavu mikono {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} iliiumba.
sw.B: bahari ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} kwa sababu {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliifanya, \q na mikono {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} iliifinyanga nchi kavu.
sw.R: Yeye aliifanya bahari, kwa hiyo ni mali {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}. \q Kwa mikono {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} mwenyewe aliifinyanga nchi kavu.

es.L: de quien [es] el mar, pues {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo hizo, \q y la tierra seca formaron {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} manos.
es.B: el mar es {{deity_pronoun:suyo|Suyo}} porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} lo hizo, \q y {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} manos formaron la tierra seca.
es.R: Él hizo el mar, así que {{deity_pronoun:le|Le}} pertenece. \q Con {{deity_pronoun:sus|Sus}} propias manos formó la tierra seca.

vi.L: biển [là] của {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm ra nó, \q và đất khô, tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nắn nên.
vi.B: biển thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã làm ra nó, \q và tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nắn nên đất liền.
vi.R: Ngài đã làm ra biển, nên biển thuộc về {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Chính tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} đã nắn nên đất liền.

decisions.choice: the sea and the dry land: the creation
decisions.reason: The pair recalls Genesis 1:9-10, where God gathers the waters and the dry land (yabbashah) appears. The King of the psalm owns the world because he made it.

decisions.choice: formed: shaped like a potter
decisions.reason: The verb (yatsar) is the potter's word, used of God forming the man from the dust (Genesis 2:7).

source.text: בֹּ֭אוּ נִשְׁתַּחֲוֶ֣ה וְנִכְרָ֑עָה נִ֝בְרְכָ֗ה לִֽפְנֵי־יְהוָ֥ה עֹשֵֽׂנוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: Come, let us bow down and bend low; let us kneel before YHWH our maker.

en.L: Come, let us bow down and bend low; \q let us kneel before {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}} our Maker.
en.B: Come, let us bow down to the ground and bend low; \q let us kneel in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, the one who made us.
en.R: Come, let us bow low to the ground. \q Let us get down on our knees in front of {{divine_name:the LORD|Yahweh}}, who made us.

fr.L: Venez, prosternons-nous et inclinons-nous ; \q fléchissons le genou devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}} qui nous a faits.
fr.B: Venez, prosternons-nous jusqu’à terre et inclinons-nous ; \q mettons-nous à genoux devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, celui qui nous a faits.
fr.R: Venez, inclinons-nous jusqu’au sol. \q Mettons-nous à genoux devant {{divine_name:le SEIGNEUR|Yahvé}}, qui nous a faits.

sw.L: Njooni, tusujudu na kuinama; \q tupige magoti mbele ya {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}} Muumba wetu.
sw.B: Njooni, tusujudu mpaka chini na kuinama; \q tupige magoti mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} aliyetuumba.
sw.R: Njooni, tuiname mpaka chini. \q Tupige magoti mbele za {{divine_name:BWANA|Yahwe}}, aliyetuumba.

es.L: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, postrémonos e inclinémonos; \q arrodillémonos ante {{divine_name:el SEÑOR|Yahvé}} nuestro Hacedor.
es.B: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, postrémonos hasta el suelo e inclinémonos; \q arrodillémonos delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, el que nos hizo.
es.R: {{plural_you:Vengan|Venid}}, inclinémonos hasta el suelo. \q Pongámonos de rodillas delante {{divine_name:del SEÑOR|de Yahvé}}, que nos hizo.

vi.L: Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy cúi lạy và khom mình; \q chúng ta hãy quỳ gối trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng Tạo Hóa của chúng ta.
vi.B: Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy sấp mình xuống đất và cúi rạp; \q chúng ta hãy quỳ trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng đã dựng nên chúng ta.
vi.R: Hãy đến, chúng ta hãy cúi rạp xuống đất. \q Chúng ta hãy quỳ gối trước mặt {{divine_name:CHÚA|Gia-vê}}, Đấng đã dựng nên chúng ta.

decisions.choice: come: come in
decisions.reason: The command (bo'u) is to come or go in. After the call to come before God in verse 2, it invites the worshipers into the temple courts.

decisions.choice: bow down, bend low, kneel: worship with the whole body
decisions.reason: The first verb (hishtachavah) is to bow to the ground, the usual act of worship; the second (kara') is to bend the knees; the third (barak) is to kneel, the same root as "bless". The three verbs together picture a full bow before the King.

decisions.choice: our Maker: the one who made us his people
decisions.reason: After verses 4-5 the word recalls creation, but "our" points to Israel too: the LORD made them his people (Deuteronomy 32:6, 15), as verse 7 goes on to say.

source.text: כִּ֘י ה֤וּא אֱלֹהֵ֗ינוּ וַאֲנַ֤חְנוּ עַ֣ם מַ֭רְעִיתוֹ וְצֹ֣אן יָד֑וֹ הַ֝יּ֗וֹם אִֽם־בְּקֹל֥וֹ תִשְׁמָֽעוּ׃

records.literal_gloss: For he [is] our God, and we [are the] people of his pasture and [the] flock of his hand. Today, if to his voice you will listen!

en.L: For {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} [is] our God, \q and we [are] the people of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} pasture and the flock of {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} hand. \q Today, if you will listen to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice!
en.B: For it is {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} who is our God, \q and we are a people {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} pastures, a flock {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} tends with {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} own hand. \q Oh, that today you would listen to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice!
en.R: He is our God. \q We are {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} people, like sheep that {{deity_pronoun:he|He}} feeds and leads. \q If only you would listen to {{deity_pronoun:his|His}} voice today!

fr.L: Car {{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} [est] notre Dieu, \q et nous [sommes] le peuple de {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} pâturage et le troupeau de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} main. \q Aujourd’hui, si vous écoutiez {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix !
fr.B: Car c’est {{deity_pronoun:lui|Lui}} qui est notre Dieu, \q et nous sommes un peuple qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} fait paître, un troupeau qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} conduit de {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} propre main. \q Ah, si aujourd’hui vous écoutiez {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix !
fr.R: Il est notre Dieu. \q Nous sommes {{deity_pronoun:son|Son}} peuple, comme des brebis qu’{{deity_pronoun:il|Il}} nourrit et conduit. \q Si seulement vous écoutiez {{deity_pronoun:sa|Sa}} voix aujourd’hui !

sw.L: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} [ni] Mungu wetu, \q nasi [ni] watu wa malisho {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} na kondoo wa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}. \q Leo, kama mtaisikiliza sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}!
sw.B: Kwa maana {{deity_pronoun:yeye|Yeye}} ndiye Mungu wetu, \q nasi ni watu anaowalisha, kundi analolichunga kwa mkono {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}} mwenyewe. \q Laiti leo mngeisikiliza sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}}!
sw.R: Yeye ni Mungu wetu. \q Sisi ni watu {{deity_pronoun:wake|Wake}}, kama kondoo anaowalisha na kuwaongoza. \q Laiti mngeisikiliza sauti {{deity_pronoun:yake|Yake}} leo!

es.L: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} [es] nuestro Dios, \q y nosotros [somos] el pueblo de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} prado y el rebaño de {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} mano. \q ¡Hoy, si {{plural_you:escuchan|escucháis}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz!
es.B: Porque {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} es nuestro Dios, \q y somos un pueblo que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} apacienta, un rebaño que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} cuida con {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} propia mano. \q ¡Ojalá hoy {{plural_you:escuchen|escuchéis}} {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz!
es.R: Él es nuestro Dios. \q Somos {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} pueblo, como ovejas que {{deity_pronoun:él|Él}} alimenta y guía. \q ¡Si tan solo {{plural_you:escucharan|escuchaseis}} hoy {{deity_pronoun:su|Su}} voz!

vi.L: Vì {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} [là] Đức Chúa Trời của chúng ta, \q và chúng ta [là] dân của đồng cỏ {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} và bầy chiên của tay {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}. \q Hôm nay, nếu mọi người chịu lắng nghe tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!
vi.B: Vì chính {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} là Đức Chúa Trời của chúng ta, \q và chúng ta là dân được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} chăn nuôi, là bầy chiên {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} tự tay chăm sóc. \q Ôi, ước gì hôm nay mọi người lắng nghe tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!
vi.R: Ngài là Đức Chúa Trời của chúng ta. \q Chúng ta là dân {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}, như bầy chiên được {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}} cho ăn và dẫn dắt. \q Ước gì hôm nay mọi người chịu nghe tiếng {{deity_pronoun:ngài|Ngài}}!

decisions.choice: the people of his pasture, the flock of his hand: the people he feeds and leads
decisions.reason: God is pictured as the shepherd of Israel (23:1; 80:2). "His hand" is the hand that guides and cares for the flock.

decisions.choice: Today, if you would listen: a wish, "if only"
alternatives: Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts (joined to verse 8)
decisions.reason: The words "if" and "you will listen" without a following "then" make a wish: the speaker longs for the people to listen. They may also be read as the start of verse 8, "Today, if you hear his voice, do not harden your hearts", as Hebrews 3:7-8 quotes them.
Hebrews quotes verses 7-11 from the ancient Greek translation as the voice of the Holy Spirit, and builds on the word "today": the offer of God's rest still stands for those who listen (Hebrews 4:7).

decisions.choice: like sheep that he feeds and leads
alternatives: the people of his pasture and the flock of his hand
decisions.reason: Readable makes the picture a comparison and says what the shepherd does (m1).

decisions.choice: "mọi người" for "you" when the singer turns to the people
decisions.reason: The singer now speaks to the gathered worshipers. "mọi người" (everyone) is a warm, neutral way to address a crowd of men and women; "anh em" names only brothers, and "các người" would be a rebuke.

source.text: אַל־תַּקְשׁ֣וּ לְ֭בַבְכֶם כִּמְרִיבָ֑ה כְּי֥וֹם מַ֝סָּ֗ה בַּמִּדְבָּֽר׃

records.literal_gloss: Do not harden your heart as [at] Meribah, as [on the] day of Massah in the wilderness,

en.L: "Do not harden your heart as [at] Meribah, \q as [on] the day of Massah in the wilderness,
en.B: "Do not let your hearts grow hard, as happened at Meribah, \q on the day of Massah out in the desert,
en.R: "Do not be stubborn like your ancestors were at Meribah, the place of quarreling. \q Remember that day at Massah, the place of testing, in the desert.

fr.L: « N’endurcissez pas votre cœur comme [à] Meriba, \q comme [au] jour de Massa dans le désert,
fr.B: « Ne laissez pas votre cœur s’endurcir, comme à Meriba, \q comme au jour de Massa, là-bas dans le désert,
fr.R: « Ne soyez pas têtus comme vos ancêtres à Meriba, le lieu de la dispute. \q Rappelez-vous ce jour-là à Massa, le lieu de l’épreuve, dans le désert.

sw.L: "Msifanye mioyo yenu kuwa migumu kama [huko] Meriba, \q kama siku ya Masa nyikani,
sw.B: "Msiiache mioyo yenu iwe migumu, kama ilivyotokea huko Meriba, \q siku ile ya Masa kule jangwani,
sw.R: "Msiwe wakaidi kama babu zenu walivyokuwa huko Meriba, mahali pa ugomvi. \q Kumbukeni siku ile huko Masa, mahali pa kujaribu, kule jangwani.

es.L: «No {{plural_you:endurezcan su|endurezcáis vuestro}} corazón como [en] Meribá, \q como [en] el día de Masá en el desierto,
es.B: «No {{plural_you:dejen|dejéis}} que {{plural_you:su corazón|vuestro corazón}} se endurezca, como sucedió en Meribá, \q el día de Masá allá en el desierto,
es.R: «No {{plural_you:sean tercos como lo fueron sus|seáis tercos como lo fueron vuestros}} antepasados en Meribá, el lugar de la pelea. \q {{plural_you:Recuerden|Recordad}} aquel día en Masá, el lugar de la prueba, en el desierto.

vi.L: "Đừng làm cứng lòng các con như [tại] Mê-ri-ba, \q như [vào] ngày ở Ma-sa trong hoang mạc,
vi.B: "Đừng để lòng các con trở nên cứng cỏi như đã xảy ra tại Mê-ri-ba, \q vào ngày ở Ma-sa trong hoang mạc,
vi.R: "Đừng cứng đầu như tổ tiên các con tại Mê-ri-ba, nơi họ đã cãi lẽ. \q Hãy nhớ lại ngày ấy tại Ma-sa, nơi họ đã thử thách {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, trong hoang mạc.

decisions.choice: God speaks from here to verse 11
decisions.reason: In verse 9 the speaker says "they tested me" and in verse 11 "my rest", so from here God himself speaks, warning his people. The words are put in quotation marks from here to the end of the psalm.

decisions.choice: Meribah and Massah: Exodus 17:1-7
decisions.reason: At Rephidim the people quarreled with Moses for water and tested the LORD, saying "Is the LORD among us or not?" (Exodus 17:7). The place was named Massah ("testing") and Meribah ("quarreling"). Numbers 20:1-13 tells of another Meribah.

decisions.choice: harden your heart: refuse to trust and obey
decisions.reason: The heart is the mind and will. To harden it is to become stubborn against God, as Pharaoh did (Exodus 9:34).

decisions.choice: your ancestors; the place of quarreling; the place of testing; Remember
decisions.reason: Readable names who was stubborn (from verse 9) and says what the two place names mean (m2).

decisions.choice: God speaks in the first person ("mimi") from here to verse 11; the people are addressed in the plural ("msifanye", "mioyo yenu")
decisions.reason: The Hebrew "your heart" is singular, but it is said to the whole people; Swahili uses its plural "you", which it has ready, so the reader hears that the warning is to everyone.

decisions.choice: "các con" for "you" when God speaks to his people in verses 8-11
decisions.reason: God speaks from here to verse 11 (see the meaning decision). He warns his own people as a father warns his children; "các con" says that, where "các ngươi" is archaic and "các người" would treat them as strangers.

decisions.choice: "nơi họ đã cãi lẽ", "nơi họ đã thử thách Ta" after the names
decisions.reason: The names mean "quarreling" and "testing" (see the meaning decision); Readable gives their sense, as the English Readable does, and says who was tested, as verse 9 does.

source.text: אֲשֶׁ֣ר נִ֭סּוּנִי אֲבוֹתֵיכֶ֑ם בְּ֝חָנ֗וּנִי גַּם־רָא֥וּ פָעֳלִֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: when your fathers tested me; they tried me, though they had seen my work.

en.L: when your fathers tested {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}; \q they tried {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, though they had seen {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} work.
en.B: when your ancestors put {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} to the test \q and challenged {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, even after they had watched {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} work.
en.R: There your ancestors tested {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} \q and kept on trying {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}, though they had seen all I had done.

fr.L: quand vos pères {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont mis à l’épreuve ; \q ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont éprouvé, alors qu’ils avaient vu {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} œuvre.
fr.B: quand vos ancêtres {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont mis à l’épreuve \q et {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont défié, même après avoir vu {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} œuvre.
fr.R: Là, vos ancêtres {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont mis à l’épreuve \q et ils ont continué à {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} provoquer, alors qu’ils avaient vu tout ce que j’avais fait.

sw.L: wakati baba zenu waliponijaribu {{deity_pronoun:mimi|Mimi}}; \q walinipima, ingawa walikuwa wameiona kazi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.B: wakati babu zenu waliponijaribu \q na kunipinga, hata baada ya kuiona kazi {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}.
sw.R: Huko babu zenu walinijaribu \q na kuendelea kunipima, ingawa walikuwa wameona yote niliyoyafanya.

es.L: cuando {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} padres {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pusieron a prueba; \q {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} tentaron, aunque habían visto {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} obra.
es.B: cuando {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} antepasados {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pusieron a prueba \q y {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} desafiaron, aun después de haber visto {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} obra.
es.R: Allí {{plural_you:sus|vuestros}} antepasados {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} pusieron a prueba \q y siguieron tentándome, aunque habían visto todo lo que yo había hecho.

vi.L: khi tổ phụ các con thử {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}; \q họ thử thách {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, dù họ đã thấy công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.B: khi tổ tiên các con đem {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ra thử \q và thách thức {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}, dù họ đã chứng kiến công việc của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.
vi.R: Tại đó tổ tiên các con đã thử {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} \q và cứ thử thách {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} mãi, dù họ đã thấy mọi điều {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã làm.

decisions.choice: tested, tried: demanded that God prove himself
decisions.reason: The two verbs (nasah, bachan) both mean to put to the test. Here it is people testing God, demanding signs instead of trusting him (Exodus 17:2; Numbers 14:22).

decisions.choice: my work: what God had done for them
decisions.reason: The work is God's rescue from Egypt and his care in the desert, which they had seen with their own eyes (Numbers 14:22).

decisions.choice: ancestors
decisions.reason: The word ('avot) means the earlier generations of the people, women and men; Balanced and Readable say "ancestors".

source.text: אַרְבָּ֘עִ֤ים שָׁנָ֨ה׀אָ֘ק֤וּט בְּד֗וֹר וָאֹמַ֗ר עַ֤ם תֹּעֵ֣י לֵבָ֣ב הֵ֑ם וְ֝הֵ֗ם לֹא־יָדְע֥וּ דְרָכָֽי׃

records.literal_gloss: Forty years I loathed [that] generation, and I said, '[They are] a people going astray of heart, and they, they do not know my ways.'

en.L: Forty years I loathed [that] generation, \q and I said, '[They are] a people who go astray in heart, \q and they do not know {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} ways.'
en.B: Forty years long I was weary and disgusted with that generation. \q I said, 'These are people whose hearts wander off; \q they have never learned {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} ways.'
en.R: For forty years they disgusted {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q I said, 'Their hearts keep wandering away from {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}}. \q They do not know how I want them to live.'

fr.L: Quarante ans j’ai eu en dégoût [cette] génération, \q et j’ai dit : “[C’est] un peuple au cœur égaré, \q et eux, ils ne connaissent pas {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} chemins.”
fr.B: Pendant quarante ans, cette génération {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}a lassé et dégoûté. \q J’ai dit : “Ce sont des gens dont le cœur s’égare ; \q ils n’ont jamais appris {{deity_pronoun:mes|Mes}} chemins.”
fr.R: Pendant quarante ans, ils {{deity_pronoun:m’|M’}}ont dégoûté. \q J’ai dit : “Leur cœur s’éloigne sans cesse de {{deity_pronoun:moi|Moi}}. \q Ils ne savent pas comment je veux qu’ils vivent.”

sw.L: Miaka arobaini nilichukizwa na kizazi [kile], \q nikasema, '[Wao ni] watu wanaopotoka mioyoni, \q nao hawazijui njia {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}.'
sw.B: Miaka arobaini nzima nilichoshwa na kuchukizwa na kizazi kile. \q Nilisema, 'Hawa ni watu ambao mioyo yao inatangatanga; \q hawajapata kamwe kujifunza njia {{deity_pronoun:zangu|Zangu}}.'
sw.R: Kwa miaka arobaini walinichukiza. \q Nilisema, 'Mioyo yao inaendelea kutangatanga mbali nami. \q Hawajui jinsi ninavyotaka waishi.'

es.L: Cuarenta años aborrecí [a aquella] generación, \q y dije: ‘[Son] un pueblo que se extravía de corazón, \q y ellos no conocen {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} caminos’.
es.B: Durante cuarenta años estuve harto y disgustado con aquella generación. \q Dije: ‘Son gente cuyo corazón se desvía; \q nunca han aprendido {{deity_pronoun:mis|Mis}} caminos’.
es.R: Durante cuarenta años {{deity_pronoun:me|Me}} causaron disgusto. \q Dije: ‘Su corazón siempre se aleja de {{deity_pronoun:mí|Mí}}. \q No saben cómo quiero que vivan’.

vi.L: Bốn mươi năm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã ghê tởm thế hệ [đó], \q và {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã phán: '[Đó là] một dân có lòng lầm lạc, \q và chúng không biết các đường lối của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'
vi.B: Suốt bốn mươi năm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã chán ngán và ghê tởm thế hệ ấy. \q Ta đã phán: 'Đây là dân có lòng hay lạc lối; \q chúng chẳng bao giờ học biết đường lối của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'
vi.R: Suốt bốn mươi năm, chúng đã làm {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} ghê tởm. \q Ta đã phán: 'Lòng chúng cứ đi lạc xa {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}. \q Chúng không biết {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} muốn chúng sống thế nào.'

decisions.choice: forty years: the years in the desert
decisions.reason: After the people refused to enter the land, God said they would wander forty years until that generation had died (Numbers 14:33-34).

decisions.choice: loathed: felt disgust
decisions.reason: The verb (qut) is to feel loathing or be sick of something (119:158).

decisions.choice: know my ways: understand and follow how God acts and what he asks
decisions.reason: To know God's ways is to understand his way of acting and to walk in it (25:4; Exodus 33:13).

decisions.choice: how I want them to live
decisions.reason: Readable says what "my ways" means here (m3).

records.literal_gloss: So I swore in my anger, 'If they will enter into my rest!'

en.L: So I swore in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger, \q 'They shall not enter into {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} rest!'"
en.B: So in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger I took an oath: \q 'They will never come into {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} place of rest.'"
en.R: So in {{deity_pronoun:my|My}} anger I made a solemn vow: \q 'They will never enter the land of rest I promised them!'"

fr.L: Aussi j’ai juré dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère : \q “Ils n’entreront pas dans {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} repos !” »
fr.B: Alors, dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère, j’ai fait ce serment : \q “Jamais ils n’entreront dans le lieu de {{deity_pronoun:mon|Mon}} repos.” »
fr.R: Alors, dans {{deity_pronoun:ma|Ma}} colère, j’ai fait une promesse solennelle : \q “Ils n’entreront jamais dans le pays de repos que je leur avais promis !” »

sw.L: Kwa hiyo niliapa katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}, \q 'Hawataingia katika raha {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}}!'"
sw.B: Basi katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} niliapa: \q 'Hawataingia kamwe mahali {{deity_pronoun:pangu|Pangu}} pa raha.'"
sw.R: Kwa hiyo katika hasira {{deity_pronoun:yangu|Yangu}} niliweka nadhiri nzito: \q 'Hawataingia kamwe katika nchi ya raha niliyowaahidi!'"

es.L: Por eso juré en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira: \q ‘¡No entrarán en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} reposo!’».
es.B: Así que en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} ira hice un juramento: \q ‘Nunca entrarán en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} lugar de reposo’».
es.R: Por eso, en {{deity_pronoun:mi|Mi}} enojo hice un juramento solemne: \q ‘¡Nunca entrarán en la tierra de reposo que les prometí!’».

vi.L: Vậy {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thề trong cơn giận của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}: \q 'Chúng sẽ không được vào sự yên nghỉ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}!'"
vi.B: Vậy trong cơn giận, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã thề: \q 'Chúng sẽ không bao giờ được vào nơi yên nghỉ của {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}}.'"
vi.R: Vậy trong cơn giận, {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã long trọng thề: \q 'Chúng sẽ không bao giờ được vào vùng đất yên nghỉ mà {{deity_pronoun:ta|Ta}} đã hứa cho chúng!'"

decisions.choice: If they enter: an oath meaning "they will never enter"
decisions.reason: In a Hebrew oath, "if" with the curse left unsaid is a strong denial: "(may I be cursed) if they enter" means they certainly will not (Numbers 14:23, 30).

decisions.choice: my rest: the land where God gives his people rest
decisions.reason: The word (menuchah) is a resting place, used of the promised land (Deuteronomy 12:9). Hebrews 4:3-11 reads it also as God's own rest, the rest of the seventh day.

decisions.choice: God's words end here
decisions.reason: The quotation that began in verse 8 closes at the end of the psalm. The psalm ends with the warning, without a return to praise.

decisions.choice: They shall not enter
decisions.reason: Even Literal says what the oath means (m1); a bare "if" would mislead.

decisions.choice: the land of rest I promised them
decisions.reason: Readable says what the rest was (m2).
